subject: Technical deep-dive: infra agenda & slot coordination
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Luca Bernardi <luca@finexa.com>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finexa.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Technical deep-dive: infra agenda & slot coordination

Hi Luca / Elena —

Thanks again for the productive discovery call this morning. Quick recap: Finexa is primarily focused on predictable token cost, KV cache behavior with long context workflows, and secure data handling for model prompts. You mentioned a need to validate latency targets for interactive workflows and confirm routing/fallback and audit log capabilities.

Next step: a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive where our ML infra and solutions engineering teams walk through architecture, demo a short live inference run, and align on integration requirements. Proposed objectives:
- Walk through serving topology and caching/kv behavior (15–20m)
- Demo: end-to-end inference with a Finexa-like workload (20–25m)
- Discussion: performance targets, quantization & cost options (15m)
- Open Q&A and action items (10–15m)

I've attached a draft agenda (redwood-tdx-proposed-agenda.pdf). Proposed slots (all PT):
- Wed 25 Feb, 10:00–11:30
- Wed 25 Feb, 14:00–15:30
- Thu 26 Feb, 13:00–14:30

Please confirm which slot works and who from Finexa will join (looks like security and infra will be useful). I'll loop in Karthik (ML infra), Sergio (Solutions), and Monica (CS) on the calendar once we lock a time.

If there are specific environment requirements, feel free to attach them — we can prep a short pre-read.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: redwood-tdx-proposed-agenda.pdf
From: Luca Bernardi <luca@finexa.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finexa.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Technical deep-dive: infra agenda & slot coordination

Vanessa —

Appreciate the recap and clear agenda. Both Elena and I are keen to move forward. A couple of notes from our side:
- Please include our security engineer Marta Lopez (marta.lopez@finexa.com) on the invite — she will want to review audit/log retention and KMS/HSM integration points.
- We have a short prioritized infra checklist that we'll attach (finexa-infra-priority-list.pdf) — can your team confirm whether Redwood supports per-customer KMS key wrapping and whether we can restrict routing to specific regions during testing?

Availability from our core team (PT):
- Wed 25 Feb, 10:00–11:30 — preferred
- Thu 26 Feb, 13:00–15:00 — also possible

If you can reserve the Wed 25 10:00–11:30 slot tentatively, we'll confirm attendees (Marta + platform + a product owner) by Monday.

Thanks,
Luca
Head of Platform | Finexa
Luca.Bernardi@finexa.com

Attachment: finexa-infra-priority-list.pdf

Subject: Fwd: Technical deep-dive: infra agenda & slot coordination

Folks —

Looping you in to coordinate the TDX for Finexa. They prefer Wed 25 Feb 10:00–11:30 PT. Can we lock that and prepare the following?
- Karthik: short slide(s) on caching (prefix/KV), KV cache warm-up, and expected latency under 1k–5k token contexts. Note: include any quantization tradeoffs and recommended model variants for cost sensitivity.
- Sergio: live demo environment; please prepare a 10–15m demo that runs a Finexa-like workflow and includes metrics output (p99 latency, throughput).
- Monica: prepare a mutual action plan template with milestones (POC -> integration -> SLA testing).

Once you confirm, I'll send a calendar invite and attach the Finexa checklist they provided.

Thanks —
Vanessa

Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Technical deep-dive: infra agenda & slot coordination

Confirming Wed 25 Feb, 10:00–11:30 PT. I created a calendar invite (calendar-invite.ics) and attached a short prep sheet (bytecloud-infra-requirements.xlsx) based on their checklist.

Refined agenda (60–75 min):
- 10:00–10:10: Introductions + objective alignment (Vanessa / Luca)
- 10:10–10:30: Serving topology & caching patterns (Karthik)
- 10:30–10:45: Demo: inference run & metrics (Sergio)
- 10:45–11:00: Cost/quantization options and routing policies (Karthik / Sergio)
- 11:00–11:20: Security & data controls (Monica + Marta)
- 11:20–11:30: Action items and next steps (Vanessa / Luca)

Karthik notes for the team: I'll include examples of prefix cache hit scenarios and a small benchmarking slide with p50/p95/p99 numbers for 1k, 2k, and 5k token cases. Sergio — can you confirm the demo will show both hosted and dedicated routing fallback?

See you all on Wed.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Staff ML Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Attachments: calendar-invite.ics, bytecloud-infra-requirements.xlsx
